objective.question_zh: 戴尔 AI 服务器收入增长有多少能转化为毛利、经营利润和现金？价格与配置、销量、价格数量组合、客户需求、供应链和上下游价值分配如何影响这一判断，哪些反方证据会改变结论？

request_planning.node_purpose: Select proposition-bound S1/S2 research requests from the current R34 tool catalog without seeing answers.
request_planning.input_scale: Twelve owner-reviewed DELL requests across seven proposition groups; no Evidence, numeric values, source URLs or expected answers are present in the initial message.
request_planning.schema_burden: small strict tool payload with up to six request identifiers
request_planning.materiality_and_quality_risk: high because omitted price, volume, supply or counterevidence lanes can bias the final value-capture judgment
request_planning.comparable_run_evidence: The predecessor R32 zero-call loop exercised all twelve requests; later natural DELL work reached an independently passed R17, while the current R34 pack and S2 bridge were promoted afterwards and therefore require a fresh consumer canary.
request_planning.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek GA thinking enabled at maximum reasoning effort
request_planning.stop_or_truncation_behavior: empty, truncated or non-tool output is a failed provider attempt; required research work is never silently dropped

reflection_and_plan_delta.node_purpose: Read exact tool receipts plus the fail-closed product-value bridge, identify what changed, and propose the next bounded request set or a justified stop decision.
reflection_and_plan_delta.input_scale: At most six request results per round, reviewed-Evidence cards, typed facts, feedback receipts, seven deterministic revenue-surface derivations and four open bridge gaps.
reflection_and_plan_delta.schema_burden: strict reflection payload plus bounded plan and hypothesis atoms
reflection_and_plan_delta.materiality_and_quality_risk: high because a false sufficient stop, invented PVM value or false public-information boundary would suppress necessary research
reflection_and_plan_delta.comparable_run_evidence: The R32 loop proved plan adaptation but did not expose the R4 product-value bridge; the R34 successor must preserve null PVM and product-profit fields while still surfacing the exact revenue bridge.
reflection_and_plan_delta.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek GA thinking enabled at maximum reasoning effort
reflection_and_plan_delta.stop_or_truncation_behavior: invalid stop authority fails closed; the failed attempt is retained and cannot be relabelled as completion

specialist_workpaper.node_purpose: Synthesize a decision-ready value-capture workpaper from reviewed Evidence, typed NumericFacts, the deterministic revenue surface, bounded estimates, scenarios and explicit bridge gaps.
specialist_workpaper.input_scale: Two bounded research rounds, up to the current reviewed DELL pack, typed S2 context, one product-value bridge and the complete feedback/reflection history.
specialist_workpaper.schema_burden: large strict workpaper tool with source, numeric, relation and gap reference enums
specialist_workpaper.materiality_and_quality_risk: very high because unsupported AI profit attribution, bundled-price ASP inference or generic boundary prose directly degrades the research product
specialist_workpaper.comparable_run_evidence: R17 passed a fresh author-separated content review on its immutable source set; the R34 canary is an interface successor only and does not reopen or supersede that content review.
specialist_workpaper.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek GA thinking enabled at maximum reasoning effort
specialist_workpaper.stop_or_truncation_behavior: truncation, unbound claims and unauthorized references are terminal failures for the attempt
